company_news.headline: Uganda Airlines Places First Boeing Order for 737 MAX and 787 Dreamliner Jets
company_news.summary: Boeing [NYSE: BA] and Uganda Airlines announced today that the national carrier is ordering four 737-8 and four 787-9 airplanes to grow and modernize its fleet. The airline's first-ever Boeing airplane purchase will support growing demand across its regional and international network.

company_news.headline: Boeing and MSC Air Cargo Announce Order for 777-8 Freighters
company_news.summary: Boeing [NYSE: BA] and MSC Air Cargo today announced that the fast-growing air cargo operator has purchased five 777-8 Freighters.

company_news.headline: Nasdaq, S&P 500 Futures Rise As Chip Rally Counters Iran Jitters Ahead Of Big Tech Earnings: Why IREN, ACHR, TSLA, BA Stocks Are Drawing Focus
company_news.summary: Chip stocks staged a comeback on Monday, gaining at the close after a sharp selloff last week.

company_news.headline: Boeing, Airbus Delivery Delays May Persist Another Five Years, BA Warns
company_news.summary: British Airways expects ongoing aircraft shortages as Boeing 777X and some Airbus deliveries remain behind schedule.

company_news.headline: Boeing Wins Key Shareholder Lawsuit Ruling
company_news.summary: Court strips shareholder case of class-action status

company_news.headline: Boeing Pushes Next-Generation Jet to End of the 2030s
company_news.summary: CEO Kelly Ortberg says Boeing will prioritize 737 production, cash flow, and debt reduction before launching a new aircraft.

company_news.headline: Boeing Lands 100-Jet SMBC Order at Farnborough Airshow
company_news.summary: SMBC Aviation Capital agreed to buy 60 737 Max 10s and 40 Max 8s in the air show's first major deal.

company_news.headline: Boeing Lands Up to 20 Dreamliner Order From Philippine Airlines
company_news.summary: Philippine Airlines plans its first direct Boeing order in nearly two decades, with deliveries starting in 2031.

company_news.headline: Boeing Wins Big As Farnborough Airshow Takes Off. Airbus, RTX Land Deals.
company_news.summary: Boeing announced orders for nearly 150 planes as the Farnborough Airshow began on Monday. Airbus, RTX, eVTOL makers secured deals.

company_news.headline: Boeing’s Big Airshow Will Decide Whether the Stock Rises or Falls
company_news.summary: Boeing investors will have a lot of news to digest this week. They should focus on supply chain updates.

company_news.headline: Delayed Boeing jets only fit for baked bean tins, Emirates boss says
company_news.summary: Boeing has been dealt a fresh blow after Emirates said it would refuse to take delivery of 10 aircraft, claiming that the much-delayed jets would be better off being turned into baked bean tins.
